items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 74:1
items.html: The first three of the Mochin, which are corrected in the MEM of Tzelem, and hence the Yud does not go out of their air and they always remain in concealed Hassadim, are therefore called by the name ring. For the correction of the MEM of Tzelem seals them and delimits them, so that they do not receive Hochma into themselves, as with a ring all around. And 'ring' (Azkal) means a ring (tabba'at). And this MEM of Tzelem is the MEM that comes in the Masora in the verse 'of the increase of his government, etc.' For although it is in the middle of the word, where a final MEM ought not to come — since it indicates that it cuts off and ends the bestowal — nevertheless there is a final MEM there. So too the first three of the Mochin, although they deserve the light of Hochma, being the first three, nevertheless do not receive Hochma, on account of the correction of the MEM in them, as above. (Page 324, Item 68).
